status: prespecified Phase 3 A0 ablation config; CNN only, seeds 101-108; (e) DIAGNOSTIC ONLY: ranges narrowed to class centre +/- 1 kPa, hardware effects on

physics.cirrhosis_eta_label: placeholder: current single-value from Source/attenuation_model.py; multi-patient distribution stays off
physics.stage_mu_range_source: outputs/phase1/code/p1_common.py STAGE_MU_RANGE_KPA, a Phase 1 assumption with no literature source

hardware.source: values from the docstring and Phase 1 example settings of Source/hardware_effects.py; the dataclass defaults themselves are all off

data.validation_note: independent records from a separate random stream, same depths and counts as training
data.stream_seed_rule: np.random.RandomState(zlib.crc32(f'{config_id}|{seed}|{stream}'.encode())) with stream in {train, val, eval_clean, eval_d0, eval_d6.5, eval_d8, eval_d10}
data.split_hash: sha256 over float64 bytes of X and int64 bytes of y for train, validation and every eval cell, in that order

evaluation.scope: sanity only: accuracy at the clean cell and at 0, 6.5, 8, 10 cm; no floors, p-value curves or permutation controls
